# Setup

```{r}
#| label:  setup

setup <- tempfile(fileext = ".r")
readLines(con = 'https://inkaverse.com/docs.r') |> 
  gsub("echo = FALSE", "echo = TRUE", x = _) |>
  writeLines(setup)
source(setup)

library(tidyverse)
library(magick)
library(cowplot)
library(tiff)
library(png)
library(jpeg)

sessionInfo()
```

# Figuras

## Importar

```{r}
plot01 <- readJPEG("cacTus.jpg") %>% grid::rasterGrob()
plot02 <- readJPEG("hojas.jpg") %>% grid::rasterGrob()
plot03 <- readJPEG("planta.jpg") %>% grid::rasterGrob()
```

## Grid plots

```{r}
plot <- list(plot01, plot02, plot03) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = .
            , nrow = 2
            , labels = "AUTO"
            )

plot
```

## Guardar figura

```{r}
plot %>% 
  ggsave2(filename = "Fig01.pdf"
          , plot = .
          , dpi = 300
          , width = 20
          , height = 10
          , units = "cm"
          )
```

## PDF to TIFF

```{r}
pdf2tiff <- list.files(".", pattern = "Fig.*pdf", full.names = T) 

imgs <- 1:length(pdf2tiff) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  filename <- pdf2tiff[x] %>% gsub(".pdf", "\\1.tiff", .) 
  
  pdf2tiff[x] %>% 
    image_read_pdf() %>% 
    image_write(format = "tiff", filename)
  
})
```


# cowplot R

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

# define a function that emits the desired plot
p1 <- function() {
  par(
    mar = c(3, 3, 1, 1),
    mgp = c(2, 1, 0)
  )
  boxplot(mpg ~ cyl, xlab = "cyl", ylab = "mpg", data = mtcars)
}

ggdraw(p1) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "cornsilk"))
```


# Grid

```{r}
# base R
p1 <- ~{
  par(
    mar = c(3, 3, 1, 1), 
    mgp = c(2, 1, 0)
  )
  boxplot(mpg ~ cyl, xlab = "cyl", ylab = "mpg", data = mtcars)
}

# ggplot2
p2 <- ggplot(data = mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg)) + geom_boxplot()

# lattice
library(lattice)
p3 <- bwplot(~mpg | cyl, data = mtcars)

# elementary grid graphics objects
library(grid)
p4 <- circleGrob(r = 0.3, gp = gpar(fill = "skyblue"))

# combine all into one plot
plot <- list(p1, p2, p3, p4) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist= .
          , rel_heights = c(.6, 1)
          , labels = "AUTO"
          , nrow = 2)

plot %>% ggsave2(plot = .,
  filename = "Figure-01.jpg",
  units = "cm",
  width = 20,
  height = 20
)

```
